description: Jest 30.5.2 with two workers (`maxWorkers: 2`, one file each): a timer `first.test.ts` set at module scope throws 300 ms after the file loaded, long after the file ended, while `second.test.ts` runs for 1.5 s in the other worker. No circus is listening in the idle worker: Jest prints the worker's `Error:` line, `first.test.ts` stays passed, the run succeeds, exit 0. Kept: the `PASS`/`FAIL` headers, the `Error:` lines and the test count. A black-box run, read by `provino`'s `jest-uncaught.test.ts`.
